findings.problem: fr style guide §Plurals: many takes « de » before a full noun (« 1 000 000 de sessions »); « ans » is a noun, not an abbreviation like min/h/j/sem. Unreachable in practice.
findings.suggestion: {count, plural, one {# an} many {# d’ans} other {# ans}}
